title: Julie C NDE 8968
content: My now ex-husband was angry and held me against the wall by my neck with my feet in the air. He didn't realize he had strangled me to death. When he released his hand, my body fell to the ground and my head bounced off the concrete floor. He laid me on the couch and tried bring me back to life. When his attempts failed, he went to check on the children. I remember seeing the light and then I moved through the wall. I was hovering over my family. At first I thought I was alive, but quickly realized I wasn't alive. I and fought to go back to my body. Then there was darkness until I awoke. My ex-husband said he was trying to figure out what to do with my body. Since coming back, I'm stronger, smarter, and feel out of place. Just this year I entered a company entry level and now run all distribution operations over the country for an eight billion dollar a year industry. Seventy-five people report to me. I was a stay at home mom, with a waitressing history before I died. I'd say my death was a blessing. When I meditate, I can go back to the light. This is frightening and feels like decades in just minutes, so I don't do it anymore. Life is an adventure. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 02/17/2016 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack Direct head injury Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function). My husband thought he had killed me and said I was not breathing for 30 minutes. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I could feel my consciousness and the light in my core At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? About 10 minutes into the experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I saw waves of light and energy. It was magical with a glow of brightness. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear more intensely than in my body. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes My family Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was dense and filled me with warmth. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Everything. But my emotions have made a 180 since the event. I'm happy and I still feel the light. I'm not the same person. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the univers? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I needed to be there for my daughters God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? I am uncertain if an afterlife exists. There's something there, but it's all around us whether we are living or dead. The waves are there if you look closely. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Don't have many After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Everything makes sense. Solutions just appear now. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Too long. I didn't pay attention to fully answering questions after certain point
